basis: Kawerak-sponsored Bering Strait Business Directory (beringstrait.biz) with browsable business pages (e.g. Nome Auto Detail), community and category listings, and free add-your-business form; Kawerak launch announcement on kawerak.org. Kawerak also serves 20 tribes in 16 communities.
notes: Directory covers regional local businesses generally, not verified as exclusively Native-owned; region is predominantly Alaska Native.

basis: apiai.org/tribes/ page exists; snippet enumerates all 13 member tribes in 10 communities (Akutan, Atka, Belkofski, False Pass, Agdaagux, Nelson Lagoon, Nikolski, Pauloff Harbor, Qagan Tayagungin, St. George, St. Paul, Qawalangin, Unga). No business directory or artist registry surfaced.

basis: Snippets identify CRNA as tribal health organization of six compacted Ahtna villages, named: Cantwell, Gakona, Gulkana, Kluti-Kaah, Mentasta, Tazlina. No business directory, artist registry, or business-development content surfaced.

basis: Snippets state KANA serves ten federally recognized Kodiak Island tribes and name communities (Kodiak, Akhiok, Karluk, Old Harbor, Ouzinkie, Port Lions, Larsen Bay); KANA helps tribes develop business opportunities and runs a CEDS-based Economic Development Program. basis: AFN runs convention Exhibitors program and Alaska Native Customary Art Fair (~170-180 Native artist vendors per third-party snippets); nativefederation.org hosts exhibitor page, booth rules/FAQ PDFs, and 2019 art-show rules form.
